data.title: Building Greek and Latin Science Words

targets.hint: Name an instrument you look through to see distant planets and stars.
targets.definition: A tool with lenses used to see things that are far away.
targets.sentenceContext: We used a large ___ to see the rings around Saturn.

targets.hint: Name a famous person's handwritten signature on a book or baseball.
targets.definition: A person's own signature written in their own handwriting.
targets.sentenceContext: The baseball player signed an ___ on my cap.

targets.hint: Name the tool used to find out how hot or cold something is.
targets.sentenceContext: The nurse checked the ___ to see if I had a fever.

targets.hint: Name the entire zone on Earth where all living things exist.
targets.definition: The parts of Earth where animals, plants, and other life live.
targets.sentenceContext: Every living organism on our planet is part of the global ___.
